evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep said: 'I just need ten to fifteen minutes of your time, if that's okay?' — framing present but no promise of a dependable quote explicitly made, and moved forward without a clear yes.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asked 'aside from the pricing, do you have any other concerns about the moving process?' — but this came after already stating the purpose of the call, not before probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised mattress wrapping concern. Rep explained options and added cost, but when customer asked 'do they unmount TVs,' rep answered and immediately pivoted to packing services without circling back to explore the mattress concern further or confirming it was fully answered.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No reflection summary. Rep acknowledged concerns individually but never said 'so what I'm hearing is...' or confirmed all concerns were covered.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment), floor/stories (3rd floor, 2nd floor), rooms (1 bedroom), walking distance (20 feet parking to stairs, 5 feet stairs to apt on first location; 20-30 feet on second), additional rooms (none), special items (75-inch TV, mattress), additional stops (single stop). All seven covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Rep asked: 'would you also like us to do packing services where we pack everything into boxes or you only want us to wrap the furniture.' Customer chose wrapping only.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provided: 'normally precious for a one bedroom apartment we finishes at three and a half hours however in your case... I actually estimate this to finish in four and a half to five and a half hours with two movers and one truck.' Personalized to stairs, TV, and drive time. Range given: $855 to $1,045.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep disclosed: '$95 per hour per mover... $190... gas and truck taxes insurance... no hidden fees of any type. No credit card fees, no transportation fees, no terrible fees... 2.5-hour minimum... prorated in fifteen minute increments.' Both fee transparency and commitment framing present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep moved directly from stating the estimate to explaining how the clock works and time-based billing. No 'does that feel fair' or equivalent pause.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No closing loop statement. Rep did not ask 'does that put those to rest' or similar.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep went directly from estimate discussion to 'would you like to secure your schedule for Wednesday?'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No 'anything coming with you we haven't talked about' or equivalent.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep said 'would you like to be on the schedule today?' — but immediately preceded by 'we do not require any deposit. So, if something comes up, if you want to reschedule or maybe cancel your move, you are free to do so' — a built-in out that softens the ask.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Rep said 'we do not require any deposit' and 'if you want to reschedule or maybe cancel your move, you are free to do so.' No explicit rate-lock or no-deposit commitment phrasing per script.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Date confirmed (Wednesday September 30th). No phone number confirmed in call. No arrival window confirmed. No crew size confirmed beyond '2 movers.' Delivery address confirmed (21255 north post oak road, Houston 77055). No notes left about concerns. Partial: 2 of 5 elements.

top_strength: Jeline gathered comprehensive logistics details (property type, floors, walking distances, special items, appliance sizes) and provided a well-anchored, personalized estimate ($855–$1,045 for 4.5–5.5 hours) with transparent fee breakdown and 2.5-hour minimum + 15-minute increment framing.
coaching_note: Critical gaps: Section 2 never moves into Two Layers Deep follow-up on the mattress wrapping concern (only acknowledged, not explored), Section 5's Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) are completely absent, Section 6's final concerns check is skipped, and Section 7's ask is softened by an immediate escape clause — rebuild the promise statements and genuine close-down checks before handing off.
